Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key points from call:
- Primary need: low-latency inference for customer-facing features (target P50 < 200ms, sustain 50 req/s)
- Data residency: US-only; sensitive PII requirement for logs
- Compliance: SOC 2, need DPA + audit logs
- Deployment preference: private VPC or Dedicated depending on SLA/cost tradeoffs

Ask / next steps for CloudNova: 
1) Stakeholder map — who is the economic buyer (VP/Dir level), who owns security/infosec, and who is procurement/legal owning contracts?
2) Legal routing preferences — NDA, MSA, DPA sequencing and expected turn-times per redline round
3) Availability for a technical deep-dive (SE + infra) next week — can Tom or the buyer join?

I'll attach our standard NDA for quick signature. Once NDA is in place, we can share the MSA + DPA and start parallel review (or follow your preferred sequencing). Proposed timeline: NDA (2 business days), MSA first review (7 business days), DPA (5 business days) — we can tighten if we agree on abbreviated redlines.

Thanks — I can take point on legal coordination from Redwood.

Marissa Cole
